whatIs: H1 Gallery collects marketing headlines from websites, each with the product's name and its own page. The archive is numbered sequentially (H—1, H—2…) and has more than 250 headlines.
It's a good fit when you need to write a landing page headline and want to see how other products handle it.
uses: Go through several headlines in a row before writing your landing page hero.
Compare how products similar to yours sum up their value proposition in a single sentence.
Subscribe to the Friday digest to see new headlines without hunting for them.
caveats: It has no search or filters: you browse the archive in chronological order, from newest to oldest.
It shows only the headline, not the full page, so you don't see the design or the rest of the message.
There are no categories by industry, so finding examples from a specific field takes time.
pricingNote: Free to browse, no account needed.
idealFor: Anyone writing landing page headlines who wants real references.
